## Type of change / 改动类型

- [ ] Bug fix / 缺陷修复
- [ ] New feature / 新功能

## How was it tested? / 如何验证？

<!-- Commands you ran and what you checked by hand. -->

## Checklist / 自查清单

- [ ] `pnpm turbo run typecheck` and `pnpm turbo run lint` pass
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the change, and `pnpm vitest run <path>` passes
- [ ] Docs under `docs/` updated if behaviour or configuration changed
- [ ] User-visible strings added to both `en` and `zh-CN`
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or personal data in the diff
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`) and uses `<type>(<scope>): <summary>`
